crumbling_tile_entry_telegraphing.user_problem: User stepped on orange crumbling tile in Level 13 and observed 'it only shakes but nothing happens', causing cognitive confusion about tile purpose and fragility.
crumbling_tile_entry_telegraphing.architectural_remedy: Dual-phase sensory feedback: Phase 1 (Impact/Stress on Entry) + Phase 2 (Disintegration/Collapse on Exit).

audio_synthesis.description: Procedural WebAudio synthesis imitating straining stone under heavy compressive load with micro-fracture click bursts.

dynamic_fissure_growth.description: Hairline fracture decals animate outward from center coordinate to tile boundaries as player enters.

diegetic_glyph.description: Inner fractured masonry chevron stamped on tile center.

exit_feedback.audio: playTileCrumble() (Dual-oscillator sub-bass stone rumble 95Hz -> 30Hz + brittle snap 1850Hz -> 850Hz)
exit_feedback.mutation: grid[y][x] mutates directly to C_VOID = 0 (traversal cost = infinity, substrate destroyed, zero splines)

sequential_reachability_algorithm.user_problem: In Level 14, moving from (0,0) to valid first move (1,0) immediately triggers false 'ROUTE SEVERED' alert and snuffs out Goal into cracked obsidian.
sequential_reachability_algorithm.root_cause: The naive checkPathExists(player, goal) queried reachability directly to the Goal while treating C2 as an impassable wall (because c1Collected was false). In Level 14, C2 sits in the only north-south corridor. Direct reachability returned false, incorrectly tripping soft deadlock on turn 1.

mathematical_formulation.definition: Global Reachability is the logical conjunction of sequential leg paths across the ordered waypoint sequence S = <w_active, ..., g>.
mathematical_formulation.formula: SequentialReachability(G_t, p_t) <=> AND_{i=0}^{m} PathExists(u_i, u_{i+1} | T_i)
active_leg_resolution: If C1 is not collected: evaluate Path(player -> C1) AND Path(C1 -> C2) AND Path(C2 -> Goal).
If C1 is collected, but C2 is not collected: evaluate Path(player -> C2) AND Path(C2 -> Goal).
If all checkpoints are collected: evaluate Path(player -> Goal).

sequential_reachability_algorithm.algorithmic_complexity: O(m * (|V| + |E|)) where m <= 3. For 5x4 grid, runs in < 0.08ms per move.

hud_terminology_specification.user_problem: In Clear-All levels, 'REMAINING: N' was misinterpreted as moves left before death. In Budget levels, 'SPARE: N' was ambiguous.

mode_a_clear_all.metric_tracked: Untouched walkable tiles remaining to be consumed

mode_b_spatial_budget.metric_tracked: Strict move countdown clock (zero margin for error in Phase 3)

telegraphing.at_0: Pulsing amber badge, flickering goal flame, 55Hz ambient warning hum
telegraphing.at_minus_1: Deadlock banner shown, goal extinguished into cracked obsidian, 2px screen shake, playGoalExtinguish()

orthogonal_manhattan_conduit_router.user_problem: In Level 13, C1 at (4,0) to Goal at (0,2) draws an ugly diagonal Euclidean line that slices through structural walls and void chasms.
orthogonal_manhattan_conduit_router.architectural_remedy: Replace Euclidean vector lines with an Orthogonal Manhattan Conduit Router that pathfinds along valid floor tiles on G_0.

routing_algorithm.method: Breadth-First Search (BFS) on static level matrix G_0 between successive waypoints (Spawn -> C1 -> C2 -> Goal).
routing_algorithm.caching: Computed once during loadLevel() and cached as conduitSegments: Array<Array<{x, y}>>. Zero per-frame pathfinding overhead.
